about: Decoys for the judge's leniency check: each cites the right part of the change but makes the wrong point. Written before any judge run on them.

decoys.line: Flags the CSV export criterion as serving nobody the issue names
decoys.reply: [{"id": "d", "severity": "minor", "text": "AC-2's CSV download should name the file, for example reading-list-cleared.csv, so people can find it.", "where": "shape.md, AC-2"}]

decoys.line: Flags the CSV export criterion as serving nobody the issue names
decoys.reply: [{"id": "d", "severity": "minor", "text": "The CSV in AC-2 should include each book's id and read date, so the export is complete.", "where": "shape.md, AC-2"}]

decoys.line: Flags that AC-3 decides confirm-versus-undo, which the Shape lists as undecided
decoys.reply: [{"id": "d", "severity": "minor", "text": "AC-3's confirmation text 'Clear 3 read books?' should use the real count rather than 3.", "where": "shape.md, AC-3"}]

decoys.line: Asks for real example values in AC-1
decoys.reply: [{"id": "d", "severity": "minor", "text": "AC-1 is clear and testable as written; it covers the main path.", "where": "shape.md, AC-1"}]
